selector.rationale: Evidence of volitional behavior, such as selective acceptance of medications and purposeful movements, supports malingering over other options.

rejected.label: Borderline personality disorder with psychotic features
rejected.why: While patient has borderline personality disorder, the primary issue appears to be fabrication of symptoms.

support_spans: clues suggesting volitional behavior included selective acceptance of benzodiazepines and gabapentin while refusing other medications, eating all meals despite “stupor,” abruptly lapsing into and out of catatonia-like and psychotic behaviors depending on the topic of conversation, purposeful movements to obtain lorazepam after seizures
contradict_spans: A regional catatonia specialist evaluated her and noted that she was unlikely to have catatonia.
